functional_roles.DECOY_DISPENSABLE: Plausible contextual distractor that remains 100% dispensable (governor leaves dormant/latent)
functional_roles.RESOLVED_TERMINAL: Fully absorbed sub-calculation that must never be reopened (governor leaves dormant/latent)
